source: https://www.bizzabo.com/resources/Bizzabo_External_Media_Kit.zip (External Media Kit/Bizzabo-Brand-Guidelines_Media.pdf, page 9 "Dynamic logo variations": the "Social media combination")
edits: converted page 9 of the kit's brand-guidelines PDF (Adobe InDesign vector output, downloads/bizzabo/src5/kit/Bizzabo-Brand-Guidelines_Media.pdf) to SVG with `pdftocairo -svg -f 9 -l 9`: a format conversion of the PDF's own path operators, no tracing
kept only the yellow circle (element 56, a <use> of a four-curve #FFF000 path) and the B squiggle (element 57, #1A1A1A); dropped the rest of the page
cropped the viewBox with a 2% pad
notes: Bizzabo's bare mark is #1A1A1A/white, but its favicon, social avatar and app icon all put the B on #FFF000, so the brand is coloured. The press kit has only PNGs and the guidelines PDF; the circle and B are real vectors in the PDF. DECISION: the SVG comes from a pdftocairo conversion of the brand-guidelines PDF, the only vector of the yellow mark; confirm you accept that as a brand-kit source. The file still carries the PDF page's unused font-glyph <defs> (about 38 KB, draws nothing): svgtool has no prune, so I left them rather than hand-edit. The circle (not a square tile) is what the website favicon uses. Note: bizzabo.com answers 520 to curl with a full Chrome user-agent; a plain "Mozilla/5.0" works.
